visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand with a gold ring and light-colored nails interacts with a white cloth dust bag labeled 'Chloé PARIS' resting inside a brown cardboard box. The hand carefully peels back the fabric to reveal a large, elaborate gold-toned earring featuring a prominent seashell and metallic charms. The background consists of a neutral beige, textured carpet under bright and even lighting. (2) The scene cuts to a medium close-up of a woman with long, straight light-brown hair. She is wearing a cream-colored knit cardigan and a gold necklace. On her left ear, she displays a large, ornate earring composed of a textured gold disc, a snail shell, and a large peach-colored seashell. She looks into the camera, tilting her head and touching the jewelry in a well-lit indoor room.
